description: Formulario Único de Edificación (FUE), 2020 is a dataset listed in Chilean national open data portal (datos.gob.cl), an open data portal, published or maintained by Instituto Nacional de Estadísticas. El carácter coyuntural de esta información y la oportunidad de su publicación le otorga un rol fundamental para usuarios de los sectores público y privado al constituir un antecedente importante para la formación de expectativas de los agentes económicos respecto de la evolución de la actividad económica del sector. Coverage: Chile. The portal files it under the publisher Instituto Nacional de Estadísticas. Its tags are Comunicaciones, Economía, Estadísticas, Transporte. The portal shows 2021-09-29 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Non-Commercial (Any). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-cl-portal.
